propositions: AcliClient caches negative (empty) search results forever with no TTL or invalidation, causing stale answers on repeated JQL queries within the same client instance
Per-JQL search memo is scoped to one reconcile pass per client, but freshness invariant is undocumented and enforced only by encapsulation violations (direct _search_cache.pop reach-ins)
Two existing call sites (access_check.py retry loop and _fresh_search test) manually evict cache entries before retry, indicating unsupported pattern that should be formalized
Bug d30c was root-caused to cached negative answer on index-visibility poll re-issuing same JQL twice on one client, where only first attempt reached Jira
Added invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method supporting per-JQL eviction and full-cache clear, migrating both reach-in sites to use documented freshness door

binding_recovery pending-recovery loop is unaffected: each JQL (primary + fallback) is distinct per pass, and cross-pass miss corroboration always receives fresh queries because each pass constructs a fresh client with fresh memo
